title: NodeState
description: `state` as reported next to a node on `GET /v1/board`. Only agent nodes currently carry state; the enum leaves room for others (e.g. table row counts) without a breaking change.

budget_status.description:
How close `spend` is to this agent's configured `budget`, if it has one. `None` means no budget is set at all -- distinct from a `Some` with both percentages absent, so a reader does not have to inspect the struct's insides to tell "no budget" from "nothing computed".

The ceiling the BOARD sets. `quota` below is the one the ACCOUNT sets, and an agent can be well inside one and stopped by the other.

fallback_until.description: Spawns use the agent's `fallback_vault` credential until this moment, because the primary credential's window is closed until then.

hosted_on.description: Where this agent's process lives: `"cloud"`, a local runner id, or `None` for **unhosted** — a first-class alarming state, not an absence (§3e). An agent nobody can run is a broken agent and the UI says so.

queued_messages.description: Messages persisted but not yet delivered into the child.

quota.description: The last usage window the harness reported, whatever its status.

resets_at.description: While `rate_limited`: when the harness said the window resets. `None` means it did not say, and `resume_at` is a backoff instead.

resume_at.description: While `rate_limited`: when the engine will resume delivery by itself.

session_id.description: The harness's own session identifier for the current session. Changes on every start and on every `ephemeral_context` clear.

spend.description: Observed spend, from the harness's usage events. Drives `budget`.

AgentStatus.description: Lifecycle of an agent node's child process.

oneOf.description: No child process. The default, and where a node lands after `stop`.
Child spawned, harness not yet ready to accept a turn.
The harness reports it has no usable credentials. Terminal until the operator completes `/v1/agents/:id/auth/*`.
Child is mid-turn (a message is being processed).
Child is alive and waiting for input.
Process stopped after `idle_timeout_secs` to save compute (§3c#14). The session id is retained and the next message resumes it transparently, so parking never loses context.
Stopped because the agent's `budget` was reached. Requires operator action; the engine will not restart it on its own.

The harness reported its usage window closed. The in-flight message was requeued, the process stopped with its session kept, and the engine resumes delivery on its own at `resume_at`. Waiting, not failing.
Child exited unexpectedly or the harness reported a fatal error; `last_error` carries the detail.

BudgetStatus.description: docs/wow-agent-brief.md #6: the same budget-proximity numbers `GET /v1/cli/usage` gives an agent about itself, surfaced on `GET /v1/board` for the UI -- one computation, two callers, so the CLI and the board can never disagree about what "80% of budget" means.

QuotaWindow.description: A usage window as the harness reported it (`rate_limit_event`).

Spend.description: Accumulated cost for an agent's current lifetime.
